zakoopt.option.frame_fence.tooltip: One GPU sync per frame instead of 7–8. Takes load off the CPU, most of all on NVIDIA.
zakoopt.option.lunar_multidraw.tooltip: Brings back batched chunk drawing in Lunar on NVIDIA. Applies after a restart.
zakoopt.option.lazy_clear.tooltip: Skips needless framebuffer switches after a clear.
zakoopt.option.no_entity_sort.tooltip: Doesn't sort the see-through parts of player skins.
zakoopt.option.item_lod.tooltip: Flat items far away (swords, tools) are drawn without their side faces.
zakoopt.option.item_lod_distance.tooltip: Distance from which items are simplified.
zakoopt.option.no_item_sort.tooltip: Doesn't sort dropped items' faces every frame. Rarely mixes up the order of see-through ones: glass, slime.
zakoopt.option.item_single_copy.tooltip: A stack on the ground is drawn as one item instead of five copies. Stacks look thinner.
zakoopt.option.resting_items.tooltip: Items lying still aren't recalculated every tick.
zakoopt.option.spawner_cull.tooltip: Doesn't draw the mob inside far spawners. The cage stays.
zakoopt.option.spawner_distance.tooltip: Past this distance the mob inside a spawner isn't drawn.
zakoopt.option.spawner_tick_cache.toolti: A spawner's mob is recalculated once a tick, not every frame.
zakoopt.option.particle_light.tooltip: Particle light is computed once a tick.
zakoopt.option.particle_physics.tooltip: Smoke, bubbles and far particles don't collide with blocks. Smoke can pass through a ceiling.
zakoopt.option.particle_lod.tooltip: Only some far particles are drawn: every second past 16 blocks, every fourth past 32.
zakoopt.option.parallel_particles.toolti: Particles are prepared on several cores when there are many.
zakoopt.option.parallel_models.tooltip: Mob, player and armour models are built on several cores.
zakoopt.option.gui_animated_items.toolti: Animated items in the interface update no faster than the monitor's refresh rate.
zakoopt.option.bidi_cache.tooltip: Remembers the layout of names and scoreboard lines.
zakoopt.option.prepared_text_cache.toolt: Remembers the ready glyphs of names and the scoreboard.
zakoopt.option.moving_block_flat_light.t: Blocks moved by a piston are lit without soft shadows while they move.
zakoopt.option.immediate_ring.tooltip: Mob and item vertices go into one big buffer, bypassing the driver. The mod checks whether it's faster and turns it off if not.
zakoopt.option.immediate_ring_force.tool: Keep the ring buffer on without checking the speed.
zakoopt.option.block_entity_cache.toolti: A double chest's other half is looked up once a tick, not every frame.
zakoopt.option.block_entity_early_cull: Early cull of far block entities
zakoopt.option.block_entity_early_cull.t: Far chests, signs and heads are dropped by the very first check.
zakoopt.option.moving_block_cache.toolti: Blocks moved by a piston are built once and then only shifted.
zakoopt.option.lookup_caches.tooltip: Remembers repeated lookups: block entity light, a piston's biome, entity renderers.
zakoopt.option.ring_zero_copy.tooltip: Vertices are written straight into the ring buffer, with no copy.
zakoopt.option.spawner_replay.tooltip: A far spawner's mob is drawn once a tick and replayed from a cache.
zakoopt.option.micro_opts.tooltip: Small speedups: fewer repeated checks and calculations.
zakoopt.option.hud_cache.tooltip: The interface is redrawn at the monitor's rate; other frames reuse the finished picture.
zakoopt.option.skin_atlas.tooltip: Player skins in one texture, all players drawn in one call.
zakoopt.option.writer_cache.tooltip: Sodium checks for its fast write path once per model, not for every cube.
zakoopt.option.outline_skip.tooltip: Skips the glowing entity outline when nothing glows.
zakoopt.option.display_cull.tooltip: Doesn't draw holograms outside the screen.
zakoopt.option.fbo_share.tooltip: The renderer and Sodium draw into one framebuffer, with no needless switches.
zakoopt.option.sign_cache.tooltip: Sign models and textures come from a cache instead of being looked up every frame.
zakoopt.option.state_pool.tooltip: Entity data isn't created anew every frame. Off with Iris shaders.
zakoopt.option.entity_lod.tooltip: Far mobs are drawn without armour, held items, capes and the skin's outer layer.
zakoopt.option.entity_lod_distance.toolt: Distance from which mobs are simplified.
zakoopt.option.player_lod.tooltip: Simplify far players too, not only mobs.
zakoopt.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod off at once to compare FPS. Your settings stay as they are.
zakoopt.option.channel.tooltip: Mod news, benchmarks and new builds first. Subscribe to the author: t.me/StarikZako
zakoopt.option.entity_anim_freeze.toolti: Far mobs and players change pose 20 times a second, not every frame. Far movement looks jerky.
zakoopt.option.entity_anim_distance.tool: Distance from which animation slows down.
zakoopt.option.update_check.tooltip: On launch, checks GitHub for a new version.

zakoopt.bench.button.in_world: Starts from the main menu: leave the world first.
zakoopt.bench.title: ZakoOpt tuning
zakoopt.bench.ramp: Finding the load · step %s · %s FPS, target %s
zakoopt.bench.legend: Switches show how things will be once applied, * marks what changes.
zakoopt.option.player_lod_distance.toolt: Distance from which players are simplified.
zakoopt.bench.lod.hint: Move the sliders: distant mobs and players are drawn simplified. Find the distance where the difference doesn't catch the eye.
zakoopt.bench.hands: Don't touch the mouse or keyboard · Esc to cancel
zakoopt.bench.intro:
The mod will check which of its features actually speed the game up on your device.

A temporary world opens with a test scene: mobs, items, chests, holograms. The scene grows step by step until FPS drops to a working level; the mod won't push your device hard. Then the features are switched on and off one by one while FPS is measured, and you pick the LOD distance and the look of dropped items by eye. It takes 3–4 minutes, progress shows in the panel on the left.

While it runs, don't touch the mouse or keyboard and don't minimize the game. Close the browser and screen recording: they skew the numbers. Esc cancels.

Your worlds stay as they are; the temporary world deletes itself. Settings change only if you apply the result.

zakoopt.bench.gain: ZakoOpt gives %s FPS in the test scene.
zakoopt.bench.compare.hint: Flip the mod and see for yourself
zakoopt.bench.items_close.hint: Toggle it: a stack on the ground is drawn as one item instead of several. If you can't tell the difference, turn it on: item piles draw faster.
zakoopt.bench.spawners: Pick how far spawner mobs show
zakoopt.bench.spawners.hint: Past this distance the mob inside a spawner isn't drawn, the cage stays. Find the distance where it doesn't bother you.
zakoopt.option.core_pin.tooltip: Keeps the game on the best cores: the X3D cache CCD, Intel P-cores, a phone's big cores.
zakoopt.blocked.cores_same: the CPU: all cores are alike
zakoopt.screen.open.tooltip: Every feature of the mod with descriptions and distances.
zakoopt.option.occlusion_cull.tooltip: Skips chunks fully hidden behind hills, ground and walls.
zakoopt.option.leaf_cull.tooltip: Skips leaf faces buried inside tree canopies. Canopies look the same from outside and draw faster.
zakoopt.option.fast_blit.tooltip: The frame reaches the window by a direct GPU copy instead of a separate draw pass.
zakoopt.option.render_scale.tooltip: The world is drawn at a lower resolution and stretched to the window with edge-aware sharpening (AMD FSR 1); the interface stays sharp. Big FPS gain when the GPU is the bottleneck.
zakoopt.option.render_scale_percent.tool: Share of the window resolution the world is drawn at.
zakoopt.option.far_leaves.tooltip: Past the distance, leaves are drawn without see-through holes, as in fast graphics. Up close nothing changes. Speeds up forests when the GPU can't keep up.
zakoopt.bench.render_scale.hint: The world is drawn at a lower resolution and stretched to the window; the interface stays sharp. Your graphics card is what limits FPS here, so this gives a big boost. Find the value where the blur doesn't bother you, or leave it off.
zakoopt.bench.forest.hint: Past the distance, leaves are drawn without see-through holes and much faster on weak graphics. Find the distance where the difference doesn't catch the eye.
zakoopt.welcome.title: ZakoOpt: tune the settings?
zakoopt.welcome: The mod checks what speeds the game up on your computer and sets itself up. Takes 3–4 minutes and leaves your worlds alone.
